title: Emit LF explicitly from owner generators
failure_signature: Restaging through repository-default filters still left twenty-four CRLF staged blobs and twenty-six LF text blobs, so staged parity remained false.
trigger_preconditions: Owner generator used platform-default text writing
Repository filters did not normalize every generated path in the candidate index
candidate_workaround: Make owner write_json and write_text use explicit newline='\n', regenerate only owner-scoped x1 artifacts, restage through ordinary Git, and verify zero CRLF staged blobs before review.
recurrence_guard: All new family generators must pin LF at write time and still review the staged index rather than relying on host filters.
rollback: Regenerate only the uncommitted owner packet from frozen definitions; do not alter inherited files, Git configuration, history, or sibling state.
scope_boundary: This method addresses owner-generated newline determinism only and proves no scientific, privacy, security, accessibility, identity, authority, or independent-reproduction claim.
